safety.text: The token pair passed into addRewards must match the established {launchAsset, rs.quoteAsset} pair so pending rewards are credited under the real quote token.; Quote reward claims on a pool with positive pendingQuote must not revert due to uncredited totalPendingRewards[realQuote].
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。
evidence: * Missing invariant: the token pair passed into addRewards is not validated to match the established {launchAsset, rs.quoteAsset} pair. As a result, external input decides which token key is used for both totalPendingRewards[...] and the incoming transfer.

* contracts/launchpad/Distributor.sol — _decreaseTotalPending(quote, amount) reverts when user later claims real quote rewards because totalPendingRewards[realQuote] wasn’t credited.
